Source-derived, edited excerpts from my research notebook. The stages, Seurat
calls, plotting idioms and ordinary analysis settings below are retained from
that notebook. Study identifiers, marker panels, cluster assignments, biological
comparisons and all results have been removed. This code has not been rerun.

Knitting displays code only. Running chunks manually requires authorized private
inputs and can create private outputs; no input objects or results are included.
Run from this project directory. The input must be a Seurat v5 object with an RNA
Assay5 and a single counts layer. Settings must supply metadata using the neutral
field `analysis_group`; its values and relationship to the study are not provided.

```{r setup, include=FALSE, eval=TRUE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(eval = FALSE, echo = TRUE, cache = FALSE)
```

## Required private inputs

`myeloid-settings.rds` is an unprovided list containing `plot_features`,
`marker_panel`, `exclude_clusters`, `contrast_a`, `contrast_b` and
`cluster_annotations`. The annotation vector must be named by cluster ID.
These inputs replace the source notebook's study-specific choices; none can be
reconstructed from this excerpt. The reference must match the input organism and
feature naming, with a `label.main` column for SingleR.

```{r private-inputs}
myeloid <- readRDS("data/private/myeloid.rds")
analysis_settings <- readRDS("data/private/myeloid-settings.rds")
dir.create("outputs/private", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
DefaultAssay(myeloid) <- "RNA"
stopifnot("analysis_group" %in% colnames(myeloid@meta.data))
```

## Re-normalization and principal components

The layer cleanup retains the original Seurat v5 approach. The numerical choices
are analysis settings, not reported feature counts, sample counts or results.

```{r preprocessing}
if (!is.null(myeloid[["RNA"]]@layers$data)) {
  print("data exists and will be removed.")
} else {
  print("No existing data found.")
}
myeloid[["RNA"]]@layers$scale.data <- NULL
myeloid[["RNA"]]@layers$data <- NULL
myeloid <- NormalizeData(myeloid)
myeloid <- FindVariableFeatures(myeloid, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)
myeloid <- ScaleData(myeloid)
myeloid <- RunPCA(myeloid, npcs = 100)
ElbowPlot(myeloid, n = 50)
DimHeatmap(myeloid, dims = 20:30, cells = 200, balanced = TRUE)
```

## Neighbors, clustering and UMAP

```{r clustering}
myeloidpc25 <- myeloid
myeloidpc25 <- FindNeighbors(myeloidpc25, dims = 1:25, verbose = FALSE)
myeloidpc25 <- FindClusters(myeloidpc25, verbose = FALSE, resolution = 0.3)
myeloidpc25 <- RunUMAP(myeloidpc25, dims = 1:25, min.dist = 1,
                       n.neighbors = 15, verbose = FALSE)
pdf("outputs/private/myeloid-clusters.pdf", width = 9, height = 4)
DimPlot(myeloidpc25, label = TRUE, reduction = "umap", cols = colors,
        split.by = "analysis_group", pt.size = 0.5)
dev.off()
VlnPlot(myeloidpc25, features = analysis_settings$plot_features, cols = colors,
        group.by = "analysis_group", pt.size = 0)
FeaturePlot(myeloidpc25, features = analysis_settings$plot_features,
            cols = c("lightgrey", "red"), order = TRUE,
            split.by = "analysis_group")
```

## Reference annotation and panel review

```{r reference-annotation}
library(SingleR)
ref <- readRDS("data/private/reference.rds")
results <- SingleR(test = as.SingleCellExperiment(myeloidpc25),
                   ref = ref, labels = ref$label.main)
myeloidpc25$singlr_labels <- results$labels
pdf("outputs/private/reference-annotation.pdf", width = 8, height = 6)
DimPlot(myeloidpc25, reduction = "umap", cols = colors,
        group.by = "singlr_labels", label = TRUE)
dev.off()
table(myeloidpc25@meta.data$singlr_labels)

myeloidbaseddegs <- analysis_settings$marker_panel
DotPlot(myeloidpc25, features = myeloidbaseddegs, dot.min = 0.1,
        col.min = 0.1, group.by = "seurat_clusters", cluster.idents = TRUE) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90),
        panel.grid = element_line(color = "grey", size = 0.01, linetype = 2))
```

## Reviewed subsetting

The original notebook excluded selected clusters and exported their barcodes.
The selection and its biological interpretation are private inputs here.

```{r reviewed-subsetting}
Idents(myeloidpc25) <- "seurat_clusters"
excluded_cells <- subset(myeloidpc25, idents = analysis_settings$exclude_clusters)
myeloidpc25 <- subset(myeloidpc25, idents = analysis_settings$exclude_clusters,
                     invert = TRUE)
excluded_barcodes <- rownames(excluded_cells@meta.data)
write.table(excluded_barcodes, "outputs/private/excluded-barcodes.txt",
            quote = FALSE, sep = "\t", col.names = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
myeloid <- myeloidpc25
```

## Cluster marker ranking

These calls demonstrate exploratory cell-level marker ranking. They do not
provide replicate-aware treatment inference or publish any biological findings.

```{r cluster-markers}
sc <- myeloid
Idents(sc) <- "seurat_clusters"
sc.markers <- FindAllMarkers(sc, min.pct = 0.25, logfc.threshold = 0.25)
write.table(sc.markers, "outputs/private/cluster-markers.tsv",
            quote = FALSE, sep = "\t", col.names = TRUE, row.names = FALSE)
sc.markers <- read_tsv("outputs/private/cluster-markers.tsv")
sc.markers %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  top_n(n = 20, wt = avg_log2FC) -> top20
pdf("outputs/private/cluster-marker-heatmap.pdf", width = 12, height = 25)
DoHeatmap(sc, features = top20$gene)
dev.off()
```

## Interchange exports

This stage exports counts, metadata and coordinates for downstream analysis.
It does not implement RNA-velocity inference. Exported matrices can be sensitive
even when their filenames are generic and must stay private.

```{r interchange-exports}
myeloid$barcode <- colnames(myeloid)
myeloid$UMAP_1 <- myeloid@reductions$umap@cell.embeddings[, 1]
myeloid$UMAP_2 <- myeloid@reductions$umap@cell.embeddings[, 2]
write.csv(myeloid@meta.data, file = "outputs/private/myeloid-metadata.csv",
          quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
counts_matrix <- GetAssayData(myeloid, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts")
writeMM(counts_matrix, "outputs/private/myeloid-counts.mtx")
write.csv(myeloid@reductions[["pca"]]@cell.embeddings,
          file = "outputs/private/myeloid-pca.csv", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
write.table(data.frame(gene = rownames(counts_matrix)),
            file = "outputs/private/myeloid-gene-names.csv",
            quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE)
```

## Exploratory group and selected-cluster contrasts

```{r exploratory-contrasts}
sc <- myeloid
Idents(sc) <- "analysis_group"
sc.markers <- FindAllMarkers(sc, min.pct = 0.25, logfc.threshold = 0.25)
write.csv(sc.markers, "outputs/private/group-markers.csv")
sc.markers %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  top_n(n = 20, wt = avg_log2FC) -> top20
DoHeatmap(sc, features = top20$gene)

Idents(myeloid) <- "seurat_clusters"
selected_contrast <- FindMarkers(
  object = myeloid,
  ident.1 = analysis_settings$contrast_a,
  ident.2 = analysis_settings$contrast_b,
  logfc.threshold = 0.25,
  min.pct = 0.25
)
write.csv(selected_contrast, "outputs/private/selected-cluster-contrast.csv")
```

## Reviewed labels and composition

```{r reviewed-labels}
Idents(myeloid) <- "seurat_clusters"
broad.cluster.ids <- analysis_settings$cluster_annotations
stopifnot(all(levels(myeloid) %in% names(broad.cluster.ids)))
broad.cluster.ids <- broad.cluster.ids[levels(myeloid)]
myeloid <- RenameIdents(myeloid, broad.cluster.ids)
myeloid$broadtype <- Idents(myeloid)
Idents(myeloid) <- "broadtype"
pdf("outputs/private/annotated-myeloid.pdf", width = 9, height = 4)
DimPlot(myeloid, reduction = "umap", cols = colors,
        split.by = "analysis_group", pt.size = 0.5)
dev.off()
```

```{r composition}
Cellratio <- prop.table(table(myeloid$broadtype, myeloid$analysis_group), margin = 2)
Cellratio <- as.data.frame(Cellratio)
colourCount <- length(unique(Cellratio$Var1))
pdf("outputs/private/myeloid-composition.pdf", width = 15, height = 8)
ggplot(Cellratio, aes(x = Var2, y = Freq)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "forest green") +
  facet_wrap(~Var1, ncol = 6, scales = "free_y") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 0.8))
dev.off()
```

## CytoTRACE scoring

This stage uses the original CytoTRACE package. Dense conversion requires
sufficient memory; expression identifiers and
the installed package version need to be checked before any private execution.

```{r cytotrace}
library(CytoTRACE)
sc <- myeloid
cyto <- as.matrix(GetAssayData(sc, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts"))
results <- CytoTRACE(cyto)
cytotrace_scores <- as.data.frame(results$CytoTRACE)
myeloid <- AddMetaData(myeloid, metadata = cytotrace_scores,
                      col.name = "CytoTRACE_score")
pdf("outputs/private/myeloid-cytotrace.pdf", width = 5, height = 4)
FeaturePlot(myeloid, features = "CytoTRACE_score", pt.size = 1) &
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "C")
dev.off()
Idents(myeloid) <- "seurat_clusters"
VlnPlot(myeloid, "CytoTRACE_score", cols = colors, pt.size = 0) +
  stat_summary(fun = median, geom = "point", size = 6, colour = "black", shape = 95)
saveRDS(myeloid, "outputs/private/myeloid-annotated.rds")
```

Small consistency edits connect the cleaned object to downstream chunks, correct
the UMAP neighbor argument spelling and use a layer accessor for counts. No
claimed findings, validated labels or numerical analysis results accompany them.
